reads.how: An isolated host initialized this exact VST3 processor, captured its default component/controller, and restored the component. Every mapped stored float was changed separately through the public VST3 parameter API at normalized endpoints and 0.25, then its captured value was patched into the initial component and reloaded. Saved values and physical plain-value readback matched; legacy enum normalized values may quantize. This records host-API serialization evidence; Kumi Rust-output reload and DAW acceptance are tracked separately. It does not prove every audible DSP behavior.

native.evidence: Native .ffp signatures, schemas and layouts were inspected outside the repository, converted by the measured slot/name mapping, and loaded through the public VST3 component API into fresh processes. The committed native fixtures are deliberately changed synthetic test cases constructed from initialized VST3 controls as recorded in fixture_construction and fixture_edits. CI-built Kumi at source revision f18a6d7e converted these synthetic fixtures with a separate requested edit, edited the resulting VST3 files again, and loaded them into fresh native instances of the exact version recorded here. Both deliberately changed controls, the complete component control array, synthetic metadata where present, internal preset names and VST3 Name metadata matched. This establishes Rust-codec conversion acceptance; DAW loading and audible DSP behavior are separate checks.

fixture_construction.controls: Decode the initialized Comp float32 controls and change only the measured plain-value control listed in fixture_edits. Serialize those controls into the native layout; One uses the verified inverse normalized transforms. Short native layouts retain only their verified prefix.
fixture_construction.header_evidence: The product signature, native schema, count and named-key layout were observed in native .ffp files examined outside the repository, not extracted from plug-in executable code. Only these structural facts and initialized VST3 controls are used to construct the fixtures; no manufacturer native preset body is copied.
